independent_review.scope: only whether the direct v02 pass visibly achieved its leading-drape goal without a new diagnostic defect; not an overall likeness score
findings: The leading left drape remains a narrow, nearly vertical split ribbon rather than the broad low ground-reaching mass in the locked reference.
Continuous yellow missing contour remains along its outer and lower edge, while magenta excess remains near the inner contour.
